We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 1321) to the molecule given in make_8_lvl2-apply_template-2 input: that input gave a list of SMILES: ["CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1"]

So the target molecule is that SMILES. We need to apply template 1321 to this molecule, get possible precursors (list of lists). Use apply_template tool.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles = that SMILES, template_id = "1321".
